scope: XMemVirtualAlloc profile 1 ordinary CPU reserve/commit operations and five page protections. Console GPU visibility, page partitions, tagged allocations and other profiles remain unsupported.
native_method: Calls the hash-verified console XMemVirtualAlloc routine with a stubbed NtAllocateVirtualMemoryEx and standard NT allocation mode. All 30 combinations of reserve, commit and reserve+commit, five standard protections and optional top-down retain the flags and protection at the NT call. This is not an actual console allocation.
guest_checks: For each of five page protections, reserve+commit, check host region metadata, write/read writable forms and release.
For each protection, top-down reserve then commit and validate the resulting memory state and protection. Reject unverified PAGE_GUARD.
limits: The native NT allocator is stubbed; physical console memory and error behavior are not compared.
Unsupported page modifiers, Xbox page flags, GPU memory and tagged allocations remain rejected.
Executable read/write pages are allocated only when specifically requested by the guest.
